mapper.select: select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time from voya_ai_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
select count(*) from voya_ai_like where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}

choose.when: select count(*) from voya_ai_attraction where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
choose.otherwise: select count(*) from voya_ai_guide where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_like (user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from voya_ai_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time from voya_ai_like where id = #{id}

select l.id, l.user_id, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, case l.target_type when 'attraction' then a.name when 'guide' then g.title else null end as target_title, case l.target_type when 'attraction' then a.cover_image when 'guide' then g.cover_image else null end as target_cover_image, case l.target_type when 'guide' then g.summary else null end as target_summary from voya_ai_like l left join voya_ai_user u on l.user_id = u.id left join voya_ai_attraction a on l.target_type = 'attraction' and l.target_id = a.id left join voya_ai_guide g on l.target_type = 'guide' and l.target_id = g.id where l.id = #{id}
